title: MICROTEKSMART Electronic Platform Weighing Scale 500kg Capacity 50g Accuracy Digital Weight Machine for Shop, Commercial and Industrial use, Mild Steel Heavy Platform size 24x24 Inches
description: Introducing the MICROTEKSMART Electronic Platform Weighing Scale, a robust commercial-grade weighing solution designed for shops and industrial environments. This high-capacity digital scale features a generous 24×24 inches mild steel platform, perfect for handling large items with ease. With a substantial 500kg maximum capacity and precise 50g accuracy, it delivers reliable measurements for all your weighing needs. The scale comes equipped with a clear digital LED display and a practical back grill support system for securing larger packages. A standout feature is its 2-day built-in battery backup with an automatic power saver mode, ensuring uninterrupted operation even during power outages. The platform's dimensions of 60×70×90 centimetres provide ample space for various item sizes, while its sturdy mild steel construction ensures durability. The complete package includes the digital weighing scale and power cable, making it ready for immediate use. This versatile weighing machine is an ideal choice for commercial establishments requiring accurate, heavy-duty weighing capabilities.
